<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def dotpos():
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            b=n['boundary']; return (min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b))
def done(): return last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('level_completed')
# Move dot to top-left of green box (38,8), then try to push out of box
def goto(t):
    d=dotpos(); m=[]
    m+= ['DOWN']*((t[0]-d[0])//2)+['UP']*((d[0]-t[0])//2)
    m+= ['RIGHT']*((t[1]-d[1])//2)+['LEFT']*((d[1]-t[1])//2)
    if m: action(m)
goto((38,8))
print("at",dotpos())
action(['UP','UP','UP'])
print("after 3xUP:",dotpos(),"done:",done())
action(['LEFT','LEFT','LEFT'])
print("after 3xLEFT:",dotpos(),"done:",done())
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
